description: Create a registration order (a price-locked quote). Returns quote{price_usd, locked_until}, payment requirements (exact amount, address, x402 accepts) and checkout_url: a prefilled /order/{id} page a human can pay from. Policy: check availability right before buying, show the quote to the human and get confirmation before paying; pass idempotency_key (retries with the same key never create a second order; if omitted, identical calls within 15 min are de-duplicated). pay_with=balance pays instantly from prepaid balance. Card: the 402 response also carries stripe_link (Stripe Link via MPP, the human approves the spend in Link) and stripe_card (card checkout); to pay by card, hand the human checkout_url and they approve the card payment themselves. dry_run=true previews quote, renewal price and blockers without creating an order.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT)

dry_run.description: preview only, nothing created or charged

showcase.description: Opt in to the public /showcase listing (only if the user asked)
